Method of Attack: Malware in the form of malicious NPM packages has recently been discovered in the npm registry. The malware author has been publishing packages with a payload in the postinstall script of the package.json file, which is executed when the package is installed.
Attack Vector: Publishing malicious packages on npm registry
Indicators of Compromise: Payload in the postinstall script of the package.json file
